custom_expected:
Step 3: Create and Edit and Delete clear automatically.
Step 4: Save succeeds.
Step 5: Bob is immediately kicked to the login page or sees a 'Your session has ended' message.
Step 7: 'Work Orders' is no longer present in the top navigation bar (top nav order: Schedule, Customers, Parts, Reports).
custom_preconds: Test user 'Tester Bob' is assigned to role 'QA Edit Target' and is currently logged in on a second browser/incognito session.
custom_steps:
1. As Admin, navigate to Settings sidebar > Roles & Permissions. Click the pencil icon on 'QA Edit Target'.
2. Locate the Work orders card. Uncheck the View checkbox.
3. Confirm Create and Edit and Delete also auto-uncheck (cascade rule).
4. Click save.
5. Switch to Bob's session. Try to navigate anywhere in the app.
6. Have Bob log back in with the same credentials.
7. Once Bob is logged back in, inspect the top navigation.
title: Role change forces an active user to log out; new permissions apply on next login
